title: BE A WAR HORSE FOR THE LORD

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “The horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory belongs to the LORD.”-  Proverbs 21:31

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
War horses are extraordinary animals. They are set apart, trained, prepared, and closely connected with their master.

They understand their master’s every movement and recognize his voice with precision. Even in the midst of danger, they remain with their master and face the battle together. They are fearless, obedient, disciplined, and willing to fight until the end.

In the same way, we must walk closely with Christ, obey His voice, and be set apart from the things of this world. We must be prepared to face every challenge for the sake of God and His Kingdom.

A war horse does not allow anyone other than its master to control it, command it, or exercise authority over it. Likewise, we must not allow the world to rule over us or have control over our lives.

Jesus Christ is the victorious King who conquered the world, sin, and Satan. He has also given us authority to stand against the enemy. Therefore, let us fight courageously in the spiritual battle, standing firm in faith.

Our spiritual forefathers fought their battles faithfully and finished their race with victory. Let us rise up among that holy company and fight the good fight of faith. Let us overcome sin and resist Satan, wearing the full armour of God and living as disciplined war horses for our King. Amen.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “The Christian life is not a playground; it is a battleground.” — Warren Wiersbe

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, train me to be Your war horse. Give me the strength to obey You, the enthusiasm to follow You, and a deep love to fight for Your Kingdom. Help me never to retreat from the battlefield, but to trust You completely in every struggle and fulfill the calling You have given me. Give me grace to stand firm until the end. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Fight alongside Jesus, the King of kings. May you be fearless in your faith, steadfast in your obedience, and unwavering in the battle for His Kingdom.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: The Christian in Complete Armour
recommended_book.author: William Gurnall
recommended_book.quote: This classic book teaches the believer how to stand firm in spiritual warfare, resist the enemy, and live victoriously through the strength God provides.
